title: Gear
heading: Hardware, Desk Setup & Tech Specs
intro: A look at my daily workstation, hardware configurations, peripherals, and everyday tech tools for programming, gaming, and creative projects.

items.name: Processor (CPU)
items.notes: Delivers strong multi-threaded performance for compiling code, running local dev servers, and high-framerate gaming.

items.name: Graphics (GPU)
items.notes: Handles 1080p/1440p gaming across titles like Genshin Impact and Honkai: Star Rail, along with video encoding and streaming.

items.name: Memory (RAM)
items.notes: Ample memory for multitasking with IDEs (VS Code, Eclipse, Spring Tool Suite), browser tabs, and background Docker containers.

items.name: Primary Storage
items.notes: Fast boot drive for Windows 11 and active programming workspace repositories.

items.name: Operating System
items.notes: Windows for gaming and general productivity paired with Windows Subsystem for Linux for native CLI and backend development.

items.name: Primary Monitor
items.notes: Smooth high-refresh experience with vibrant color accuracy for coding sessions, UI design, and gaming.

items.name: Keyboard
items.notes: Tactile and responsive typing experience for long coding marathons.

items.name: Mouse
items.notes: Configurable DPI profiles and lightweight ergonomics for precise control.

items.name: Headphones / Audio
items.notes: Comfortable earcups with clean audio separation for listening to HoYo-MiX OSTs and Discord voice chat.

items.name: Desk Surface
items.notes: Anti-fray stitched surface covering both keyboard and mouse area.

items.name: Smartphone
items.notes: Daily communication, testing responsive web layouts, and mobile productivity.

items.name: Earbuds
items.notes: Compact audio gear for commutes and college study sessions.
